description: This file defines the LazyOpenStream class which implements the StreamInterface. It provides a lazy-loading mechanism for file streams, opening the file only when an IO operation is needed.

classes.name: LazyOpenStream
classes.description: A stream decorator that lazily opens a file stream upon first IO operation.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the LazyOpenStream with the target filename and mode.

methods.name: createStream
methods.description: Creates and returns the underlying stream when needed, opening the file lazily.
